narr: Showers and storms developed inland of South Carolina and over the southern Appalachians of North Carolina. Resultant storm boundaries led to scattered to numerous storms in the Piedmont of central North Carolina, where some isolated flash flooding occurred in Stanly County.
ev: A small stream was overflowing and crossing Joy Road. The road was impassable.
